## Load analysis data

Analysis dataset
```{r}
load('RData/Analysis_dataset.RData')
sm_data_analysis_children = sm_data_analysis %>% filter(Age<15, !is.na(BUN), !is.na(Lactate), !is.na(Hb))
dim(sm_data_analysis_children)
sm_data_analysis_adults = sm_data_analysis %>% filter(Age>=15, !is.na(BUN), !is.na(Lactate), !is.na(Hb))
dim(sm_data_analysis_adults)
```


## Venn/Euler diagrams

```{r imputed_data}
load('RData/imputed_analysis_datasets.RData')
sm_data_imputed_children = imp_data[[1]] %>% filter(Age<15)
sm_data_imputed_adults = imp_data[[1]] %>% filter(Age>=15)
```


function

```{r}
make_euler_sm = function(Cerebral, SevereAnaemia, Uraemia, Acidosis){
  # Euler input: Count all relevant combinations
  fit <- euler(c(
    "Cerebral" = sum(Cerebral & !Uraemia & !Acidosis & !SevereAnaemia),
    "Uraemia" = sum(!Cerebral & Uraemia & !Acidosis & !SevereAnaemia),
    "Acidosis" = sum(!Cerebral & !Uraemia & Acidosis & !SevereAnaemia),
    "Anaemia" = sum(!Cerebral & !Uraemia & !Acidosis & SevereAnaemia),
    
    "Cerebral&Uraemia" = sum(Cerebral & Uraemia & !Acidosis & !SevereAnaemia),
    "Cerebral&Acidosis" = sum(Cerebral & !Uraemia & Acidosis & !SevereAnaemia),
    "Cerebral&Anaemia" = sum(Cerebral & !Uraemia & !Acidosis & SevereAnaemia),
    "Uraemia&Acidosis" = sum(!Cerebral & Uraemia & Acidosis & !SevereAnaemia),
    "Uraemia&Anaemia" = sum(!Cerebral & Uraemia & !Acidosis & SevereAnaemia),
    "Acidosis&Anaemia" = sum(!Cerebral & !Uraemia & Acidosis & SevereAnaemia),
    
    "Cerebral&Uraemia&Acidosis" = sum(Cerebral & Uraemia & Acidosis & !SevereAnaemia),
    "Cerebral&Uraemia&Anaemia" = sum(Cerebral & Uraemia & !Acidosis & SevereAnaemia),
    "Cerebral&Acidosis&Anaemia" = sum(Cerebral & !Uraemia & Acidosis & SevereAnaemia),
    "Uraemia&Acidosis&Anaemia" = sum(!Cerebral & Uraemia & Acidosis & SevereAnaemia),
    
    "Cerebral&Uraemia&Acidosis&Anaemia" = sum(Cerebral & Uraemia & Acidosis & SevereAnaemia)
  ))
  
  
  plot(fit, fills = c("pink", "darkgreen", "orange","purple"), labels = TRUE, edges = TRUE,quantities = T)
}
```


```{r euler_diagram_children}
# Create logical vectors
Cerebral_imp = sm_data_imputed_children$Coma == 1
mean(Cerebral_imp)
Cerebral_obs = sm_data_analysis_children$Coma == "Yes"
mean(Cerebral_obs)

Uraemia_imp = sm_data_imputed_children$log10_BUN > 1
mean(Uraemia_imp)
Uraemia_obs = sm_data_analysis_children$BUN > 10
mean(Uraemia_obs)

Acidosis_imp = sm_data_imputed_children$Lactate > 5
mean(Acidosis_imp)
Acidosis_obs = sm_data_analysis_children$Lactate > 5
mean(Acidosis_obs)

SevereAnaemia_imp = sm_data_imputed_children$Hb < 5
mean(SevereAnaemia_imp)
SevereAnaemia_obs = sm_data_analysis_children$Hb < 5
mean(SevereAnaemia_obs)

table(SevereAnaemia_imp|Acidosis_imp|Uraemia_imp|Cerebral_imp)
make_euler_sm(Cerebral = Cerebral_imp, SevereAnaemia = SevereAnaemia_imp, Acidosis = Acidosis_imp, Uraemia = Uraemia_imp)

make_euler_sm(Cerebral = Cerebral_obs, SevereAnaemia = SevereAnaemia_obs, Acidosis = Acidosis_obs, Uraemia = Uraemia_obs)

```
